node.statement: If B is a finite-dimensional C*-algebra, A is a finite-dimensional extended epsilon-C*-algebra, v:B->A is linear, and 0 <= delta <= delta', then if v is an extended delta-inclusion it is an extended delta'-inclusion, and if v is an extended delta-isomorphism it is an extended delta'-isomorphism and in particular an extended delta'-inclusion.
